headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 9, 2026**
article:
The Atlanta Braves secured a decisive victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, winning 10-5. Jake Mangum led the Braves' offense with a standout performance, collecting 4 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs in 5 at-bats. The New York Mets also secured a win, defeating the Kansas City Royals 7-3 behind Sean Manaea's 7.0 innings pitched. The Yankees dominated the Tampa Bay Rays 12-4, with Ben Rice leading the Yankees' offense with 2 home runs and 5 RBIs.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, including Minnesota Twins right-hander Mick Abel, who has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. The Athletics have also placed 3B Zack Gelof on the 10-day injured list with a right knee laceration. The New York Mets have placed 1B Mark Vientos on the 10-day injured list with a right hand fracture.

The Minnesota Twins have made a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Tommy Nance from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for catcher Ryan Sprock and future considerations. The New York Mets have also made a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger from the Detroit Tigers for cash.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Royals 7-3**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a 7-3 victory over the Kansas City Royals, with Sean Manaea earning the win after 7.0 innings pitched. Tyrone Taylor led the Royals' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, while Juan Soto's 21st homer of the season was a key play for the Mets.

top_news.title: **Yankees Rout Rays 12-4**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees dominated the Tampa Bay Rays, securing a 12-4 victory. Ben Rice led the Yankees' offense with 2 home runs and 5 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cubs Fall Short in Baltimore**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs dropped a 2-3 decision to the Baltimore Orioles, as Seiya Suzuki led the Cubs with 3 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs. Trevor Rogers pitched 6 strong innings for the Cubs, allowing 1 earned run on 5 hits.

top_news.title: **Twins RHP Mick Abel Lands on 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Minnesota Twins right-hander Mick Abel has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation.

top_news.title: **Twins Acquire Tommy Nance in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins have acquired right-handed pitcher Tommy Nance from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for catcher Ryan Sprock and future considerations.
